title: Zonal collapsible shell — mobile-first IA draft
body:
Purpose
---
This is a working draft describing a 'zonal' collapsible shell for the Console focused on mobile-first behavior and progressive reveal of navigation. Goal: reduce navigational noise for small screens while preserving direct deep linking for power users and programmatic routes for integrations.

High-level idea
---
- Break the left-hand surface into three semantic zones:
  1) Global Actions (top): product-level controls that should always be accessible (search, create, global help)
  2) Task Surface (middle): persona-driven primary tasks (projects, models, deployments, evals). This area is the main list of actions and may adopt tile or compact list modes.
  3) Context Footer (bottom): environment/context switches, persona settings, workspaces. Hidden by default on mobile.
- On narrow viewports the shell collapses to a single 'chevron' affordance; tapping reveals zone-level chips that slide in prioritized order.
- Progressive reveal: we show a small set of primary tasks by default (2–4) and expose a secondary drawer with full IA. The objective is to keep initial tap targets shallow for discoverability.

Routing contract
---
- Every visible top-level tile maps to a canonical route (e.g., /projects, /models/:id, /deployments/:id/overview).
- Deep link invariant: collapsed shell must not rewrite canonical URLs. If a user opens a direct link, shell expands to the correct zone and highlights the active node.
- Back/forward stack: zone open/close is visual state only and should not create browser history entries unless the user explicitly navigates to a different canonical route.

Wireframe notes (quick sketches)
---
Mobile collapsed state (sketch):
[TOP]  = Search / New + icon
[CHEVRON] -> opens zone chips
Zone chips: [Workspaces] [Tasks] [Settings]
Tap Tasks -> overlay with 3 primary tiles and 'More' button.

Desktop narrow state:
- Shell width 72 px collapsed (icons only). Hover expands to 240 px with pinned state.
- When in 'compact' mode, sub-route breadcrumbs appear above content area rather than inside the left rail to preserve vertical rhythm.

Accessibility/keyboard
---
- Keyboard users should be able to: tab into shell, arrow to switch zones, and press Enter to open.
- When a zone overlay is open, focus must trap within the overlay until closed (escape to dismiss).
- Ensure sufficient color contrast for selected tile states and focus rings for compact icons.

Behavioral edge cases and decisions needed
---
- Q: Should 'More' open an in-place scrollable list or a full-screen modal on mobile? Proposal: full-screen modal for discoverability; in-place scroll for desktop.
- Q: Do workspaces live in Context Footer or as a persistent top-level zone? Leaning to Context Footer but with fast-switcher in Global Actions.
- Q: How aggressively do we hide low-frequency admin routes? Suggest burying them behind 'More' but exposing in search and command palette.

Telemetry and success metrics (what to measure)
---
- Click-through rate on primary tiles (target > 70% of launches from primary set after 2 weeks of rollout).
- Time-to-first-task on mobile (median session seconds).
- Search/command-palette fallback rate (how often users use search vs nav).
- Frequency of accidental route opens (indication of discoverability problems).

Backlog grooming (minimal work breakdown, rough priority)
---
- CONSOLE-1310: Shell CSS variables + responsive breakpoints (owner: eng-front-end) — small — P0
- CONSOLE-1311: Zone chip component + animations (owner: dxc) — medium — P0
- CONSOLE-1312: Mobile full-screen drawer + focus trap (owner: eng-accessibility) — medium — P0
- CONSOLE-1313: Deep link highlight logic + route mapping tests (owner: platform-routing) — medium — P1
- CONSOLE-1314: Workspaces fast-switcher in Global Actions (owner: product-search) — small — P1
- CONSOLE-1315: A/B rollout plan + telemetry events (owner: analytics) — small — P1

Notes for engineering
---
- Avoid coupling visual collapsed state to route shape. Keep a shell-state store separate from router state.
- Use low-level CSS animations (transform + opacity) to maintain 60fps during zone transitions.
- Provide a graceful degradation: on JS disabled, the shell should render as a stacked vertical navigation (all zones visible).

Design constraints and tokens
---
- Max collapsed width: 72px. Expanded rail: 256px.
- Primary tile height (mobile): 56px. Secondary list item height: 44px.
- Motion: 180–220ms ease-out for slide-in.

Open questions / research to run
---
- Quick hallway testing: show 6 engineers a prototype and record where they expect 'deployments' to live (top vs middle).
- Run mobile-first funnel test: does having only 3 primary tiles reduce time-to-first-task?
- Evaluate keyboard-only flows for power users and measure command-palette adoption.

Appendix: quick micro-interactions
---
- Chevron press: pulse + micro-delay then slide overlay. If long-press, show quick-actions (create new project, new deployment).
- Holding on a tile should surface a small contextual menu: pin, copy link, open in new tab.

Quick grooming notes from sync 2024-11-20
---
- Becca: prefer 'More' as full-screen on mobile.
- Arjun: wants the command palette to always show 'Open in new tab' for deep links.
- Tomás: add analytics for zone open/close frequency.

Next steps (action items)
---
- Prototype mobile drawer in Figma (owner: Becca) — due 2024-11-22.
- Engineering spike for deep-link invariant (owner: Arjun) — 3d spike.
- Create tickets for CONSOLE-1310 through CONSOLE-1315 and triage sprint assignment (owner: Sasha).

Rough sketch links (in-file notes)
---
- Figma file: //figma.com/file/xxxx/Zonal-Shell (internal)
- Please annotate with component IDs for animation handoff.

(End of draft)
